boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Sacramento
boards.description: A practical set of currently documented late-hour food stops on or near the Sacramento State area, with drive-thru or dine-in details stated conservatively.

cards.title: Denny's on College Town Drive
cards.subtitle: 7900 College Town Dr., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Use the all-hours listing for a meal when other kitchens have closed; check the location page before leaving for service changes.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour, full-service option in the College Town area.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its restaurant at 7900 College Town Dr. as open 24 hours and identifies walk-ins, takeout, lunch, dinner, and round-the-clock breakfast service.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day; walk-ins are welcome.

cards.title: The Melt on Fair Oaks Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2070 Fair Oaks Blvd., Ste. 160, Sacramento, CA 95825
cards.notes: Plan a pickup, dine-in, or delivery meal from this Fair Oaks Boulevard location; confirm the posted day’s hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A late-night burger and grilled-cheese destination listed less than a mile from Sac State.
cards.evidence_claim: The Melt's location page places this restaurant less than one mile from Sacramento State University and says it is open until midnight every day.
cards.source_title: The Melt — 2070 Fair Oaks Blvd., Sacramento
cards.access_notes: The official FAQ says this location is open until midnight every day; it offers pickup, dine-in, and delivery.

cards.title: Chick-N-Guys on Power Inn Road
cards.subtitle: 3311 Power Inn Rd., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: For a late meal, use the restaurant’s online ordering or visit during its listed Monday–Saturday midnight closing window.
cards.short_summary: A Power Inn Road chicken restaurant with documented midnight service most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-N-Guys lists its Sacramento address and hours of 11 a.m.–midnight Monday through Saturday, with Sunday hours ending at 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Monday–Saturday 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. and Sunday 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: NY Gyros & Philly's — La Riviera Drive
cards.title: NY Gyros & Philly's on La Riviera
cards.subtitle: 7670 La Riviera Dr., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Choose this La Riviera location for a late pickup order and use the weekday or weekend closing time shown on its official locations page.
cards.short_summary: A La Riviera food stop with midnight hours most nights and a later weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: NY Gyros & Philly's lists its La Riviera Drive location open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours for 7670 La Riviera Dr.: 10 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday; 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 8750 La Riviera Dr.
cards.title: Jack in the Box on La Riviera Drive
cards.subtitle: 8750 La Riviera Dr., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when arriving after the lobby closes; verify the day-specific closing time on the official location page.
cards.short_summary: A La Riviera drive-thru with late-night hours documented through the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 8750 La Riviera Dr. drive-thru open until 2 a.m. most days and until 2:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 8750 La Riviera Dr.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours end at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the lobby closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on La Riviera Drive
cards.subtitle: 7590 La Riviera Drive, Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: For a late food run, follow the location’s drive-thru schedule rather than its earlier dine-in closing time.
cards.short_summary: A La Riviera drive-thru that runs past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 7590 La Riviera Drive drive-thru open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-thru hours through 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Folsom Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 5625 Folsom Blvd., Sacramento, CA 95819
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru schedule for a Folsom Boulevard option after evening dining rooms close, and check the posted hours first.

cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 5625 Folsom Blvd. drive-thru open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists drive-thru hours to 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1300 Howe Ave. drive-thru open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours run to 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.subtitle: 4318 Marconi Ave., Sacramento, CA 95821

cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 4318 Marconi Ave. drive-thru open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-thru hours to 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Carl's Jr. on Folsom Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 8397 Folsom Blvd., Sacramento, CA 95826
cards.notes: Use this Folsom Boulevard location for an evening meal and confirm the specific day’s closing time before you travel.

cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr. lists its restaurant at 8397 Folsom Blvd., Sacramento, CA 95826, as closing at midnight.
cards.access_notes: The official Carl's Jr. location page states that this restaurant closes at midnight.
